summaryEn: 1354Z: 1.4(a) observed 1 UAP near 34SCE7566990098. At FL160–FL170 the UAP's speed was 40 knots and remained constant. 2243Z: 1.4(a) observed 2 possible UAPs near 35TQK1580995057. Their speed was estimated at 278 knots; they increased speed and changed course toward the south.
